Sofia, the February thread answers it: the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living). Kwame said "Sofia's retail account is the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, then. Not the container pickup," and you confirmed it. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, so the container pickup is the one that belongs there.

I only checked the channel history, not the delivery records themselves, so if you need the door 6 record for a specific date, that would have to come from the dock system.
